verdict.rationale: Mistral Document AI is an OCR, annotation and document Q&A API. Because its Document QnA feature is LLM-driven, consuming external tools is a plausible axis for it. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of MCP client support or any way to register external tool servers. The SDKs, batching and playground items do not address plugging in MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
